goal: Add a Sailing-skill quest helper that overlays NPC dialogue choices and step-by-step waypoints, without auto-advancing dialogue or simulating input.
success_criteria: Plugin builds against the current RuneLite client without warnings.
Manifest description names every user-visible feature shipped in the diff.
No reflection, no java.awt.Robot, no Runtime.exec, no JNI.
constraints: Use the existing QuestStep API; do not introduce a parallel state machine.
Feature scope is overlay-only — no input automation, even where it would be convenient.

decisions.what: Use existing QuestStep API; do not introduce a parallel state machine.
decisions.why: Existing patterns are well-tested and other helpers depend on them.
decisions.consequences: Adding a new step type means extending QuestStep, not subclassing in this plugin's package.

decisions.what: No prayer-flick or DPS-boss hints — out of scope for Sailing.
decisions.why: Those would invite policy rejections under simulated_content.

attempts.tried: Hooking the dialogue widget directly to auto-advance choices.
attempts.learned: That crosses the line into input automation; reverted before commit.

open_questions: Is the Sailing XP table stable across worlds, or does it differ on tournament worlds?
next_step: Land the Sailing quest helper, then add the Fishing trawler refresh as a follow-up.
